title: ROADMAP-GH-NATIVE-1: Run the whole system on GitHub alone (long-term option; Cloudflare stays the runtime until then)
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** quarterly tick, or when the Cloudflare account is unavailable for 24 h
**Done check:** file:docs/issues/ROADMAP-GH-NATIVE-1.json
**Status:** closed scaffold only

Rowan 2026-11-13: the system started on Cloudflare for Workers and AI, and the owner does not yet know how to port it to GitHub; running entirely on GitHub would be fantastic, and acceleration today is sustainable only on Cloudflare. Cloudflare is the primary runtime; this item keeps the second route real. Scaffold: (1) the tick, lane, gate, sweeper and executor logic is runtime-neutral JS with injected fetch and a D1 shim (seed/worker/src), so a GitHub-hosted runner can call the same functions; (2) a GitHub-native runtime would use scheduled workflows plus a SQLite or repo-file store in place of D1, and a hosted model API in place of the Workers AI binding; (3) blockers to measure first: the Actions minute quota (2011 of 2000 used by day 13), scheduler unreliability (5 firings in 1011 runs), no free model inference. First step: a probe that runs one tick through the same code on a runner and records parity against the Worker tick (ops/ghnative-parity.jsonl).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 171.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
